title: Budget Burn Alert Simulator
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will calculate the day on which each of four cost alerts (50%, 80%, 100% of budget, and month-end forecast) fires for a month with a runaway daily spend, to the exact day.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the day on which each of four cost alerts (50%, 80%, 100% of budget, and month-end forecast) fires for a month with a runaway daily spend, to the exact day.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) The 100% alert gives enough warning. (2) A forecast alert fires at the same time as the 50% alert. (3) Spend that is normal for 9 days means the month is on budget.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of the four alerts the learner types a day number before the sim plays the month. An answer is correct when it equals the day computed by the Rules. Mastery is 4 of 4 correct, with at most one wrong attempt across the four. Exploration is not evidence.
